title: 实现看板组件 (Implement Kanban Board Component)
body:
## 实现看板组件 (Kanban Board Component) ✅

### Status: Complete and Ready for Merge

Implementation of a fully functional, schema-driven Kanban board component for Object UI.

### Latest Update - Main Branch Merge ✅
- ✅ Successfully merged latest main branch changes
- ✅ Resolved merge conflicts in:
  - `apps/playground/src/data/examples.ts` - Integrated both Kanban and Calendar-View examples
  - `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/index.ts` - Added both kanban and filter-builder imports
- ✅ All tests passing (10 tests across components package, total 18 tests)
- ✅ All packages build successfully
- ✅ No TypeScript errors or build failures

### Recent Updates (Code Review Fixes)
- ✅ Wrapped helper functions (`findCard`, `findColumnByCardId`, `findColumnById`) with `useCallback` for performance optimization
- ✅ Removed redundant state management in renderer - now passes `schema.columns` directly to `KanbanBoard`
- ✅ Removed `console.log` debug statement from production code
- ✅ Simplified renderer component by removing unnecessary wrapper logic

### Completed Tasks
- [x] Explore repository structure and understand component patterns
- [x] Identify component architecture (UI components, renderers, and registry)
- [x] Create base UI component for Kanban board (`packages/components/src/ui/kanban.tsx`)
- [x] Create renderer for Kanban board (`packages/components/src/renderers/complex/kanban.tsx`)
- [x] Update exports in `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/index.ts`
- [x] Update UI exports in `packages/components/src/ui/index.ts`
- [x] Add drag-and-drop library dependencies (@dnd-kit packages)
- [x] Build and verify compilation
- [x] Test the Kanban component in the playground
- [x] Create comprehensive example with 5 columns and 10 cards
- [x] Verify drag-and-drop functionality (within and between columns)
- [x] Code review - **PASSED** ✅
- [x] Security check (CodeQL) - **PASSED** ✅ (0 vulnerabilities)
- [x] Create comprehensive documentation
- [x] Address all code review feedback
- [x] Merge main branch and resolve conflicts
- [x] All tests passing after merge

### Component Features
The Kanban board component provides:
- ✅ **Multiple columns** - Unlimited columns with customizable titles
- ✅ **Rich cards** - Title, description, and multiple badges per card
- ✅ **Drag & drop** - Smooth drag-and-drop using @dnd-kit library
- ✅ **Reordering** - Cards can be reordered within the same column
- ✅ **Cross-column moves** - Cards can be moved between different columns
- ✅ **Column limits** - Optional capacity limits with "Full" indicator
- ✅ **Card counters** - Shows current count and limit per column
- ✅ **Schema-driven** - Pure JSON/YAML configuration (no code needed)
- ✅ **Tailwind CSS** - Native Tailwind styling with full customization
- ✅ **TypeScript** - Full type safety with TypeScript interfaces
- ✅ **Event callbacks** - onCardMove callback for custom event handling
- ✅ **ScrollArea** - Integrated scroll areas for long card lists
- ✅ **Responsive** - Works across different viewport sizes
- ✅ **Optimized Performance** - Helper functions memoized with useCallback

### Technical Implementation
**Dependencies Added:**
- `@dnd-kit/core@^6.3.1` - Core drag-and-drop functionality
- `@dnd-kit/sortable@^8.0.0` - Sortable lists support
- `@dnd-kit/utilities@^3.2.2` - Utility functions for drag-and-drop

**Files Created:**
- `packages/components/src/ui/kanban.tsx` (248 lines) - Base UI component
- `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/kanban.tsx` (103 lines) - Schema renderer
- `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/README-KANBAN.md` - Complete documentation

**Files Modified:**
- `packages/components/package.json` - Added dependencies
- `packages/components/src/ui/index.ts` - Export Kanban component
- `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/index.ts` - Import Kanban renderer
- `apps/playground/src/data/examples.ts` - Added comprehensive example

### Screenshots
**Kanban Board in Playground:**

### Usage Example
```json
{
  "type": "kanban",
  "className": "w-full h-[600px]",
  "columns": [
    {
      "id": "backlog",
      "title": "📋 Backlog",
      "cards": [
        {
          "id": "card-1",
          "title": "User Authentication",
          "description": "Implement user login and registration flow",
          "badges": [
            { "label": "Feature", "variant": "default" },
            { "label": "High Priority", "variant": "destructive" }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "in-progress",
      "title": "⚙️ In Progress",
      "limit": 3,
      "cards": [...]
    },
    {
      "id": "done",
      "title": "✅ Done",
      "cards": [...]
    }
  ]
}
```
